services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Creating your boat listing is quick and easy! Just enter your full name, email, and create a password. Once you save your information, you can edit your profile and add your boat details. Once your listing is approved, your boat will be visible to millions of potential renters on RentABoat.com. As a boat owner, you can expect to receive tentative rental requests either via email or text message. It's important to note that at this stage, contact information will be exchanged between you and the potential renter.
